hypotheses.justification: Replace setIntegral_congr_fun hD'm with setIntegral_congr_fun₀ hD'.nullMeasurableSet. IsFundamentalDomain supplies null-measurability, and the remaining pointwise proof is unchanged. This also handles nonmeasurable fundamental domains and null sets.

Only ideleNorm_mul_principal needs this instance in the proof. Prove its required equality locally using the measurable space borel (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) and BorelSpace instance ⟨rfl⟩. Its equality is independent of that choice: ideleNorm uses distribHaarChar, which internally chooses the Borel measurable space. The conclusion, schwartzBruhat, and ThetaSum do not use the additive adele measurable structure; integrable_zetaIntegrand requires only the retained idele instances. Thus the same proof works even when the supplied additive measurable space is not Borel.
